originals.why: Natural Welsh, and the mutation in 'wnaeth hi gynnig' is correct. cynnig has the taught sense.
Wrong sense. Here cynnig means handing someone a physical thing (a glass of water), which Korean says with 권하다. The course taught cynnig as 제안하다 (to propose), and '물을 제안했어' is not natural Korean.
